changes_made.explanation: Added RoBERTaSum and BERT-Sum models that were evaluated in the paper. Normalized ETC model name and kept table-to-text generation as 'Other' since it's not a standard category.

automatic_metrics: Content Ordering (complement of normalized Damerau-Levenshtein distance)

changes_made.explanation: Simplified all metric variants to base forms (ROUGE instead of ROUGE-1/2/L, Content Selection instead of precision/recall/F1 variants). Grouped related metrics under broader categories.
No LLMs were used as judges in this paper. The paper uses traditional evaluation methods.

guideline: Participants were shown two summaries of an NBA game and asked to compare them with respect to informativeness and readability
Annotators compared generated summaries on informativeness and readability using pairwise judgments

changes_made.explanation: Removed redundant guideline descriptions while keeping the core evaluation procedure. Criteria remain the same.

overall_notes: The paper is well-focused on NLG evaluation with extractive summarization and table-to-text generation. The extraction was generally accurate but included many redundant metric variants that were simplified to base forms. The paper does not use LLMs as judges but does conduct proper human evaluation.
